hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member A_i is recovered as O_i[F] by substituting its catalog argument for z in F(z)=G(z): G0001 -> G(a), G0002 -> G(b), G0003 -> G(c).
required_assumptions: G is declared as an undefined function of one variable.
a, b, and c are declared symbols distinct from z.
Member expressions are not simplified or evaluated beyond direct substitution.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: Catalog members are applications of the same declared function symbol G to different declared arguments a, b, and c. A single latent master function F(z)=G(z) with substitution operators accounts for the observed SAME_FUNCTION_FAMILY and SUBSTITUTION_INSTANCE relations without introducing hidden names or physical concepts.
